info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Invoices-v4-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Invoices API provides a streamlined way to access and retrieve invoice details related to retail orders. This API allows businesses to view transaction invoices, track order payments, and manage financial records efficiently. Typical consumers include finance teams, inventory managers, and third-party accounting systems looking to integrate invoice data. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their order management processes and ensure accurate financial reporting.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the invoice associated with specific orders. Use this to get detailed invoice information, including itemized charges and payment status.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the invoice details of an order. This request should contain the necessary identifiers and parameters to obtain the correct invoice data. Ensure that all required fields are correctly populated to avoid errors.

ListRetailOrdersInvoicesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to orders and invoices, formatted as a JSON string.

ListRetailOrdersInvoicesResponse_200.title: Invoice Response

status.description: Indicates the status of the invoice operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the invoice.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the invoice operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message associated with the response, providing additional information.

audit.description: Audit information related to the invoice operation.

ListRetailOrdersInvoicesResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving invoice operations from orders.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the invoice.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the invoice creation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the creation and automation status of the invoice.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A lower value suggests a faster response time.
